description: Busliniennetz is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cloud.goettingen.de. Bus route network of the Göttingen transport companies. This includes the line network in the urban area of the city of Göttingen as well as Bovenden and Rosdorf. The intercity bus network is not included. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Bus network" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, TRAN, Busliniennetz, ÖPNV. The listing shows 2024-04-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
